title: Re-graphing a small-slope C^1 graph over a nearby n-plane T0 (slope <= 1/7)
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} (q q₀ : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (c : Rn n) (d : Rn ℓ) (r ε ϑ : ℝ), 0 < r → 0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ 1 / 24 → 0 ≤ ϑ → ϑ ≤ 1 / 12 → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 v (closedBall 0 r) → v 0 = 0 → (∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) r, ‖fderivWithin ℝ v (closedBall 0 r) x‖ ≤ ε) → (∀ x : Rn n, infDist (q (graphPoint x 0)) (rotatedPlane q₀ : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ ϑ * ‖x‖) → y = q₀ (graphPoint c d) → ∃ f : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (ball c (r / 2)) ∧ (∀ w ∈ ball c (r / 2), ‖fderiv ℝ f w‖ ≤ 1 / 7) ∧ (∀ w ∈ closedBall c (r / 2), ∃ x ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) r, y + q (graphPoint x (v x)) = q₀ (graphPoint w (f w)) ∧ ‖graphPoint x (v x)‖ ≤ r) ∧ (∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) r, ∀ (w : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), y + q (graphPoint x (v x)) = q₀ (graphPoint w b) → w ∈ closedBall c (r / 2) → b = f w)
